title: Author spec file conforming to Fedora Packaging Guidelines
input: An open-source utility needs a spec file for submission to Fedora. What modern Fedora guidelines must be followed regarding release numbering, changelogs, and license expressions?
evidence_requirements: Declaration of valid SPDX license identifier (e.g., Apache-2.0, MIT, GPL-2.0-or-later)
Exclusion of redundant Group: tag and BuildRoot tags obsolete in modern Fedora

title: Diagnose isolated mock build failure on Fedora Rawhide
input: A package builds on a developer's Fedora 40 workstation but fails in `mock -r fedora-rawhide-x86_64` with compiler errors about missing headers. How does the maintainer diagnose and resolve this issue?
evidence_requirements: Inspection of mock build logs (build.log and root.log)
Identification of missing BuildRequires absent in the clean Rawhide chroot
Fixing the spec by adding appropriate BuildRequires and re-verifying with mock

title: Enforce Fedora strict unbundling policy for third-party libraries
input: An upstream C project includes embedded copies of `sqlite3.c`, `cJSON.c`, and `zlib` in its source tree. Fedora packaging policy strictly forbids bundled libraries. How should this be handled in the spec file?
evidence_requirements: Removal of bundled source directories in %prep (e.g., rm -rf vendor/)
Addition of system BuildRequires: sqlite-devel, cjson-devel, zlib-ng-compat-devel
Patching or passing build flags to force the build system to link against system shared libraries

title: Execute scratch build and analyze task logs on Koji build system
input: Before pushing an update to Fedora dist-git, how does a maintainer test the build across all official architectures (x86_64, aarch64, s390x, ppc64le) using Koji?
evidence_requirements: Submission of scratch build using fedpkg scratch-build --srpm or koji build --scratch
Monitoring task status and analyzing per-architecture build.log files
Verification that all architecture builders succeed before committing to dist-git

title: Create Bodhi update for stable release with automated gating
input: A package build succeeds in Koji for `f40`. What is the procedure to submit this package as an update to Fedora 40 users via Bodhi, and what gating criteria must be met before it reaches stable?
evidence_requirements: Creation of Bodhi update via fedpkg update or Bodhi web UI/CLI
Specifying update type (bugfix, security, enhancement) and referencing resolved bug IDs
Testing gating: package goes to updates-testing, requires positive karma (+3) or 7-day aging period

title: Maintain spec compatibility across Fedora and EPEL 9/10
input: A maintainer wants to use a single spec file for both Fedora 40 and EPEL 9. EPEL 9 has older CMake and does not have the modern `%meson_build` defaults. How is the spec file structured?
evidence_requirements: Use of conditional macros based on 0%{?rhel} and 0%{?fedora}
Handling older toolchains in EPEL (e.g., cmake3 vs cmake, gcc-toolset)
Ensuring BuildRequires and macros conditionally resolve on both RHEL and Fedora targets
